name: The Joy of Extradimensional Spaces
source_section: BOOK DESCRIPTION, p.17; OPENING THE PORTAL, p.18
full_text: Heavy tome with ornately tooled leather covers decorated with gold filigree. Cover illustration: bust of an imposing spellcaster (DC 12 Intelligence Arcana or History to recognize as Mordenkainen). Contains Fistandia's marginal notes in arcane shorthand detailing how she created a permanent Mordenkainen's magnificent mansion and recording the command word 'scepter' to open the doorway. DC 13 Intelligence (Arcana) to decipher the shorthand; otherwise the Avowed can help.
summary: Fistandia's annotated tome on extradimensional spaces. DC 13 Arcana to decipher the entry command word 'scepter'. DC 12 Arcana/History to recognize Mordenkainen on the cover.
properties: Contains the entry command word 'scepter' (DC 13 Arcana to decipher). Mordenkainen bust on cover (DC 12 Arcana/History to identify).

name: Onyx Imp Figurine
source_section: IMP FIGURINE sidebar, p.18; CONCLUSION, p.25
full_text: Appears to be a detailed onyx carving of an imp. Actually a real imp that Fistandia summoned and transformed into a statuette. Removing the figurine from the mansion breaks the enchantment and releases the imp, which immediately attacks the carrier. Matreous carries it out and is killed.
summary: Cursed statuette: real imp bound by enchantment that breaks when removed from the mansion. Kills Matreous.
properties: Enchantment holds only while inside the mansion. Removing it releases the bound imp which attacks the carrier. This is what kills Matreous and triggers the conclusion encounter.

name: Puzzle Book L
full_text: The book on the reading desk in M13 is the puzzle book with the letter L on its spine.
summary: Gilded letter L on spine. Found on the reading desk in M13 (Chained Library).
properties: One of 7 books spelling LIBERTY. Gilded L on spine, Mordenkainen bust image.

name: Weapons Rack (M4)
full_text: Weapon rack containing 4 daggers, 4 quarterstaffs, and 20 darts in a bandolier. All mundane but finely made. Wall has diagrams of staff and dagger attack/parry positions.
summary: Mundane weapons: 4 daggers, 4 quarterstaffs, 20 darts. Finely made but not magical.
properties: 4 daggers, 4 quarterstaffs, 20 darts (bandolier). All mundane, finely made.
